- Target close: 2027-01-21 (aligns with Summit AI Q1 rollout window)
- Key milestones: Pilot sign-off, Security review complete, Pricing approval, Production deployment
- Owners: Summit AI: Jamie / Ravi; Redwood: Ben (sales), Monica (CS), Laura (legal)
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, Data ingestion S3 credentials, Contract redlines

Next steps / asks for this week:
1) Jamie: please confirm owners and dates you own on the MAP (sheet "Owners & Dates").
2) Ravi: can you confirm the status of the S3 access and whether your infra team can provide a service account by 12/10?
3) We'll iterate the MAP and circulate v1.2 by 12/06; can we plan a 15-min checkpoint next Thurs (12/09) to lock timelines?

Attached: SummitAI_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (initial draft), Redwood minimum security brief (for your infra team).

Thanks — I appreciate the quick alignment.

—Ben
